section_summary.extract_value: This section details the results for women, focusing on the factor analysis of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) data. It describes the statistical procedures used, including Bartlett's test of sphericity and Kaiser–Meyer–Olkin measure, and the resulting one-factor solution for the BAS. The section also mentions the internal consistency of the BAS for female participants and refers to Table 2 for means, standard deviations, and Pearson r correlations of measures, including a moderate negative correlation between BAS and BMI for women. The analysis was conducted separately for women and men to preserve internal validity, indicating a single study with gender-separated data.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the factor analysis of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) data, specifically for women. It reports on Bartlett's test of sphericity and Kaiser–Meyer–Olkin measure, supporting the unidimensionality of the BAS. Internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha) for female participants was good. Table 2 presents means, standard deviations, and Pearson r correlations for various measures, including BMI, for both women and men, indicating separate analyses for these two sample subsets within the study.
